summary: Verified XOK'S Game v2 white-panel + Reviews section changes end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass. GET /api/products/xoks-game returns image_bg='light', image=/game-blue-v2.png, gallery of 4 v2 images, 4 colors (Azul/Amarelo/Laranja/Verde) all pointing to *-v2.png. All 4 /game--v2.png images return HTTP 200 with image/* content-type and are natively white (#FEFEFE) at all corners. Frontend /produto/xoks-game: main-image panel computed background = rgb(254,254,254) (uniform #FEFEFE), no drop-shadow class on , thumbnails also on white; other product detail pages (xoks-pro-elite verified) render with dark linear-gradient bg as expected. Color swatches switch product-main-image src correctly (Verde -> /game-green-v2.png). Size guide dialog opens with size-row-S/M/L/XL. Add-to-cart with size M opens cart sheet. /produtos grid: xoks-game card panel bg=#FEFEFE, other 3 cards keep the dark linear-gradient. Reviews section present with review-item-0..4 on xoks-game AND xoks-pro-elite (rendered inside ProductDetail after ProductShowcase). Zero console errors on all tested pages.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductShowcase applies inline style backgroundColor #FEFEFE to main panel + thumbnails when image_bg==='light'; also correctly omits drop-shadow-2xl and dark gradient. Clean conditional.
ProductGrid mirrors the same lightBg pattern on the card image container.
Reviews.jsx is a static component (5 curated reviews) rendered per product page. Consider parameterising per-product in future if reviews should differ per SKU.

Backend seed() uses $setOnInsert for existing products which is safe but means product edits to SEED_PRODUCTS won't propagate to already-seeded DBs. In this run the DB already contained v2 URLs, so no action needed; note for future changes.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_ prefixed product/athlete/partnership + one order created & cleaned by pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline: 4 active products, 5 athletes. xoks-game has image_bg='light' and 4 color variants pointing to /game-{blue|yellow|orange|green}-v2.png (white-background PNGs). Panel bg is inline #FEFEFE. Reviews component is static and rendered on every ProductDetail page below ProductShowcase (data-testid reviews-section, review-item-0..4).
